title: Right coefficient descent follows by transposition from its left square
statement: For operations A,B at one coefficient stage and A′,B′ at another, coefficient functors TX,TY, fixed coefficient comparisons a,b and fixed refinement comparisons p,q, the left conjugation square a.q inverse followed by TY(p.left) followed by b.q equals q.left after TX implies the right conjugation square b.b inverse followed by TX(p.right) followed by a.b equals q.right after TY. All units and counits are those of these given operations; no geometric assumption is added.

proof.text: Cancel b.b.hom and apply injectivity of the inverse Hom bijection of A′. The two coefficient counit equations identify the images of a.b.hom and b.b.hom. Naturality of a.q.inv and the counit equation of p turn the old right comparison into its left comparison. Substitute the assumed left square. Naturality of q.left and its counit equation produce the same transpose on the other side, proving equality.

lean.statement: theorem right_coefficient_square_of_left {X Y : Scheme.{max u v}} {s t : Stage.{max u v} l} (A B : Operation.{u, v} l Ω X Y s) (A' B' : Operation.{u, v} l Ω X Y t) (TX : C.{u, v} l Ω X s ⥤ C.{u, v} l Ω X t) (TY : C.{u, v} l Ω Y s ⥤ C.{u, v} l Ω Y t) (a : FieldComparison.{u, v} l Ω A A' TX TY) (b : FieldComparison.{u, v} l Ω B B' TX TY) (p : RefinementComparison.{u, v} l Ω A B) (q : RefinementComparison.{u, v} l Ω A' B') (h : ∀ K, a.q.inv.app K ≫ TY.map (p.left.hom.app K) ≫ b.q.hom.app K = q.left.hom.app (TX.obj K)) (L : C.{u, v} l Ω Y s) : b.b.inv.app L ≫ TX.map (p.right.hom.app L) ≫ a.b.hom.app L = q.right.hom.app (TY.obj L)
